title: What to expect from Downgrading Your Plan

question.author: member_032
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for downgrading your plan?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: After 90 days, over-quota files are moved to the recycle bin and those shared links expire. To keep everything, either free up space or upgrade again within the 90-day window. When you downgrade to a plan with less storage, CloudBox never deletes your data immediately. Files above the new quota become read-only/download-only for 90 days, and new uploads are blocked. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
